items.label: HANDMADE STRAPS
items.value: The upper section is made from hand-woven nylon cord, the soles are soft synthetic material. Every pair of our unique women's braided sandals are handcrafted with the utmost care and attention. Easily adjust the straps to a comfortable position and the sandals stay with your feet wherever you go

items.label: VACATION SHOES
items.value: Whether you’re going on a outdoor cruise, a beach holiday or a day trip out. These durable & attractive sandals you’ll need

items.label: COMFORTABLE SOLES
items.value: EVA Midsole + Rubber Outsole. Soft and comfortable EVA cushioned midsole feel like you're walking on a cushion of air. The strong rubber is used for the soles and include an arch support allowing these to be good for hiking and long distance walking as they stop your feet from getting tired

items.label: WADABLE SANDALS
items.value: You can wear our casual summer sandals on the beach, while kayaking or any activity involving water without worrying about ruining them

items.label: SUMMER COMPANION
items.value: Our sandals are Suitable for young girls, nurse, teenagers or women and ladies of all ages. Please check our chart to find the right size for you. (Available sandal sizes 6, 7, 8, 9, 10 and 12)

items.label: Special Features
items.value: Arch Support, Lightweight, Padded, comfortable, soft-ground
